title: Iran Says Agreement With Oman Bars US and Israeli Vessels From Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran said it is close to finalizing an agreement with Oman on jointly managing navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, including a shared shipping route and Iranian-run traffic monitoring, maritime security, and environmental protection. Tehran said the arrangement bars US and Israeli vessels from the strait, with violators fined up to 20% of cargo value. Iranian officials stressed the deal governs vessel movement only and does not itself reopen the waterway; Iran is demanding the US lift its naval blockade, withdraw regional forces, and end the war before the strait fully reopens to broader traffic.

media.caption: Iran says Oman agreement bars US and Israeli vessels from the Strait of Hormuz

confidenceReason: Reported by two independent Tier-2 wire/outlet sources, but terms are based on Iranian official statements not yet confirmed by Oman or the US.
